value.rationale: An affine rank-one Veronese slice is a geometrically natural kernel for additive finite-field filtering, where exact recovery rank and singular-value conditioning are meaningful. The classification is complete for all finite fields and all positive dimensions, and the asymptotic recoverable fraction detects a parity-oscillating defect confined to characteristic two, quantified by explicit nonzero Euler products. It is not a cosmetic reformulation of an individual Gaussian-sum evaluation; it supplies an exact infinite-family nullity and stability invariant with a structural characteristic transition.
